title: Use directional layout APIs instead of EdgeInsets.only(left/right) and Positioned(right:) in gamification widgets
why: tier_icon_box.dart's lock badge is pinned to the visual right/bottom corner with plain Positioned, which does not mirror under RTL — in Hebrew locale the badge renders on the leading (left) corner instead of the trailing corner. This is not hypothetical: the sibling file progress_summary_card.dart (same presentation/widgets/ directory) carries an explicit comment describing this exact bug ('With a plain Positioned(right:) it stayed on the visual right — the LEADING edge in Hebrew RTL — and collided with the right-aligned header text') that was fixed there with PositionedDirectional but never applied to tier_icon_box.dart. reward_config_header.dart's EdgeInsets.only(left:4, right:4) is currently symmetric so it renders identically in both directions today, but is one one-sided edit away from the same class of bug and still fails the AX-1 grep/lint intent.
recommendation: Replace Positioned(right:, bottom:) with PositionedDirectional(end:, bottom:) in tier_icon_box.dart; replace EdgeInsets.only(left:, right:) with EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start:, end:) in reward_config_header.dart.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn 'Positioned(' lib/features/gamification/presentation/widgets/tier_icon_box.dart shows PositionedDirectional, not Positioned with right:/left:.
A widget test pumped under Locale('he')/TextDirection.rtl asserts the lock badge sits on the trailing (left-in-RTL) corner.
